'''Soghi Esper''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] of the [[Republic Army]]. During the [[Third Galactic War]] he was stationed at the [[Joint Operations Base]] of the [[Invasion Zone]] on [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]], where he provided training to other [[Republic trooper]]s.<ref name="Legacy" />
